title: procurementpurchaseordergoodsreceiptaudit
description: Fase 1 Skenario Pengadaan & Pembelian: Admin Pusat (Master) melakukan Purchase Order (PO) untuk SELURUH produk (100 pcs each), diselesaikan dengan metode Hutang (Accounts Payable), melakukan Penerimaan Barang (Goods Receipt). Audit TestSprite: Verifikasi stok Gudang Pusat tepat 100 pcs untuk setiap produk, jurnal pembelian seimbang sempurna (Dr. 1210 Persediaan, Cr. 2110 Hutang Usaha), dan harga akurat bebas dari bug desimal ratusan juta.

title: branchstockdistributionaudit
description: Fase 2 Distribusi Cabang: Admin Pusat melakukan transfer stok 10 pcs untuk SEMUA produk dari Gudang Pusat (Branch 1) ke cabang anak (Branch 2). Tugas Audit TestSprite: Memastikan stok cabang anak bertambah menjadi 10 pcs per produk, stok Gudang Pusat tersisa tepat 90 pcs per produk, dan jurnal mutasi antar-cabang seimbang.

title: extremeoperationalandexploitaudit
description: Fase 3 Uji Operasional Ekstrem: 1. Eksploitasi POS Cabang: Mencoba menjual barang dengan stok 0 via scan barcode / API checkout, sistem backend WAJIB menolak dengan HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity (tidak ada bypass stok!). 2. Transaksi POS barang valid, memastikan TIDAK ADA bug desimal (nilai transaksi dan jurnal konsisten). 3. Pencatatan Beban Operasional (Expenses). 4. Pembayaran Hutang PO (AP Payment). 5. Retur Penjualan & Retur Pembelian.

title: reportcenterandfinancialstatementaudit
description: Fase 4 Audit Modul Pusat Laporan: 1. Uji Laporan Penjualan (Sales Report): Memastikan Grand Total Penjualan cocok dengan total riil transaksi POS dan bebas dari bug desimal ratusan juta. 2. Uji Universal Transaction Viewer: Membuka detail transaksi/struk riwayat dan memastikan Harga Satuan, Subtotal, dan Total Transaksi ditampilkan benar. 3. Uji Laporan Keuangan (Laba/Rugi & Neraca): Memverifikasi total Pendapatan (4xxx), HPP (5xxx), Beban (6xxx), dan Kas/Aset (1xxx) akurat dan Neraca 100% Seimbang (Balance).

title: postapicheckoutprocesspossale
description: Test the POST /api/checkout endpoint to ensure it processes POS sale transactions correctly by validating cart items, deducting inventory stock, calculating totals, generating receipts, and creating accounting journal entries.

title: postapistocktransfersmovement
description: Test the POST /api/stock-transfers and GET /api/stock-transfers endpoints to verify inter-branch stock transfers, stock deduction at source branch, stock addition at destination branch, and insufficient stock validation (422).

title: postapijournalsaccountingentry
description: Test the POST /api/journals endpoint to verify double-entry journal creation, ensuring balanced debit and credit amounts are accepted (201) and unbalanced entries are rejected with validation error (422).

title: getapiproductsbarcodelookup
description: Test the GET /api/products/barcode/{barcode} endpoint to verify quick barcode scanner lookup for POS terminals, returning correct item metadata and price.

title: crudbranchmanagementsuperadmin
description: Test the GET /api/branches and POST /api/branches endpoints to verify branch listing, branch creation, and multi-store tenant isolation.

title: multiroleposaccountingsimulation
description: Full end-to-end multi-role retail & accounting simulation: Admin Pusat transfers stock to Cabang 1, Kasir Cabang 1 performs multiple POS sales with discount and normal items, and Accounting Ledger is audited to verify debit-credit balance, cash collected, COGS recognition, gross profit, and remaining inventory valuation.

title: distributorpurchasepayablesimulation
description: Flexible Distributor Accounts Payable simulation: Admin Pusat creates Purchase on credit (Rp 5.000.000), pays installment 1 (Rp 2.000.000), attempts invalid overpayment (rejected with 422), pays installment 2 (Rp 3.000.000), verifying dynamic status (unpaid -> partial -> paid), remaining debt calculation, and balanced double-entry accounting journals (Dr. 2110 Hutang Dagang, Cr. 1110/1120 Kas/Bank).
